title: Man and the Painting
description: A middle-aged man in a dark shirt stands in a dilapidated, rain-soaked room holding a white cup, staring at a large ornate gold-framed painting. The painting depicts a bloody, mutilated zombie wielding an axe while another monstrous figure attacks in a gore-filled hallway.
prompt: A weary middle-aged man in a dark uniform holding a paper coffee cup stands inside a decaying abandoned building with rain pouring through a broken skylight. He stares at a massive ornate golden frame painting on the wall that shows a horribly mutilated zombie with exposed guts and blood dripping, wielding a bloody axe, with another zombie figure behind it in a gore-splattered hallway. Cinematic lighting, ultra realistic details, horror atmosphere.
